digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter package structure and module loader
propositions: Eight Jira-specific root modules must be physically moved into adapters/jira/ package as a single atomic change per ADR 0035
The lazy_load function must be taught to resolve location-pinned modules (adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) via relative subpaths without breaking root module resolution
All surviving dotted imports and sibling file path references across the codebase must be repointed to new adapters/jira paths atomically with the move
Test fixtures using direct imports or path constants for moved modules must be rewritten to reference adapters.jira.* paths and new file locations
No re-export shims may remain at old root paths and zero references to old paths must survive in src/ and tests/ after completion
